notes: Adds true browser-style multi-skin document tabs across the top of AO3 Skin Studio. Multiple skins can stay open at once with independent controls, gradients, images/GIF state, required-tag settings, header settings, and previews. The + button creates a new blank skin; tabs can be switched, renamed by double-clicking, duplicated, closed, or closed except active. Loading a Starter now creates a new skin tab instead of overwriting the current skin, and Randomize Entire Skin creates a separate randomized skin tab. Open skin tabs are persisted between launches, while local image bytes remain session-local for safety/size. Keeps the direct Windows installer and all prior tools.
